items.text: Selling your home in Barcelona
We study your home and its market, set the price and the strategy, and one advisor takes the sale through to signing.
Before going to market
A good sale starts *long before the listing goes live*

items.title: Honest advice
items.text: Before you put your home on the market, we give you our honest view on whether the time is right, how to go about it and which strategy to follow.

items.title: A preliminary study
items.text: We study your property, its paperwork and your local market so you can decide with the facts in hand and fewer surprises along the way.

items.title: A valuation report
items.text: It all starts with a [valuation report](service:valoracion), where we analyse your home's market value, recommend an asking price and define the best sales strategy.
Valuation
How much is *your home worth?*
Ask for an instant online estimate, or for a valuation by an advisor who studies your home in depth.

items.title: Online valuation
items.text: Enter your home's details in our valuation tool and get an indicative estimate of its value.

items.title: Valuation with an advisor
items.text: We visit your home, review its paperwork and study your neighbourhood's market to give you a complete report.
items.cta: Request a valuation with an advisor

items.text: If you choose the advisor, we call you to arrange the visit, see the home and its paperwork, and give you the report with our comments. You can ask for it even while you are still deciding; if you are not sure yet whether to sell, start with an [initial consultation](route:services#asesoramiento).
Valuation with an advisor
Leave us your details and a HousySpace advisor will call you to value your home in person.

items.text: Asking price
How we set *the asking price*
The price doesn't come from a portal or a figure per square metre.
We explain it before anything is published: market value, recommended asking price and the offers your home will compete against.
The deals we have brokered are on the map, district by district: [see the properties we have brokered](route:sale#pisos-vendidos).
We set it with a report that brings together
Similar homes sold and for sale in the area
Sales data for the neighbourhood
The cadastral and planning situation
The real condition of the home and the building
The result
Market value and recommended asking price
How we do it
Every step matters. *We take care of it*
Eight steps in three phases and a single advisor from start to finish. You decide; we take care of the rest.
Phase 1
Before listing
Price and paperwork ready before you go to market.

items.title: Valuation
items.text: We study the property, the neighbourhood and the market, with a comparables analysis, to set the market price and a fair, competitive asking price.

items.title: Preparation
items.text: We gather and check all the paperwork needed to sell.
Phase 2
On the market
Your home, well presented and constantly monitored.

items.title: Listing
items.text: We present your home on our website and on the main property portals.

items.title: Monitoring and progress reports
items.text: Every two weeks we give you a progress report and meet you to review how the market is responding.

items.title: Viewings
items.text: We organise, attend and supervise viewings with genuinely interested buyers.
Phase 3
Up to signing and beyond
We negotiate, close and stay with you after the sale too.

items.title: Negotiation
items.text: We negotiate on your behalf and defend your price and your terms up to signing. Whether to accept an offer is always your decision.

items.title: Signing
items.text: We review the closing documents and go with you to the notary.

items.title: After the sale
items.text: We transfer the utilities (electricity, water and gas) into the buyer's name and take care of settling the taxes on the sale.
Monitoring and transparency
We keep you *in the loop throughout*

Selling a home isn't just about listing it and organising viewings. Throughout the marketing period, we analyse how the market responds and prepare progress reports so you can follow how the sale is going.
We show you how the listings are performing, the sales activity so far, the buyers' feedback and how your home compares with other properties in the area.
We meet you to go over the reports, explain our conclusions and decide on the next steps together. Because we want you to have all the information you need to make sound decisions.

Brokerage agreement
Why *exclusive?*

When several agencies compete to sell a home, speed can win out over the quality of the deal. With exclusivity, we prioritise a careful strategy to defend your home's price and reduce the risks of the transaction.

Frequently asked questions
What people ask us when selling

items.q: How long does it take to sell a flat in Barcelona?
items.a: It depends on the price, the area, the condition of the home and demand at the time, which is why we don't promise deadlines. What shortens a sale most is going to market with a well-studied asking price and the paperwork ready. With the progress reports we see every two weeks how the market is responding and decide with you whether anything needs adjusting.

items.q: What paperwork do I need to sell my flat?
items.a: We gather it and check it with you before listing: title deed and land registry extract, habitability certificate, energy performance certificate, the latest IBI property tax receipt and the community of owners' certificate, among other documents depending on the case. The architect we work with arranges the habitability certificate and the energy certificate.

items.q: What is the progress report and how often do I get it?
items.a: Every two weeks we give you a report on how the listings are performing, the sales activity, the viewings and buyers' feedback, and how your home compares with others in the area. We meet you to go through it and decide the next steps together.

items.q: What costs and taxes does the seller pay?
items.a: The usual ones are the municipal capital gains tax (plusvalía), income tax on the gain (IRPF), cancelling the mortgage if there is one, and the necessary certificates. Every case is different: before setting the price we explain what applies to you, together with the tax advisory firm we work with.

items.q: Can I sell if the flat has a mortgage, is rented out or was inherited?
items.a: Yes. Each situation has its own steps: cancelling the mortgage at signing, taking the tenant's rights into account or completing the inheritance before selling. We go through them at the start, with the law firm we work with, so no surprises appear halfway through the transaction.

items.q: Is an online valuation good enough to set the price?
items.a: It's a good first reference, but it doesn't replace a study of your home and of actual sales in the area. We explain why in the article [Is the online valuation of your flat reliable?](route:blog) and, if you want a reasoned figure, start with a [valuation with an advisor](service:valoracion).

items.text: "Don't worry, *I'll take care of it.*"

Many sales fall through over an unexpected issue: a missing habitability certificate, a mortgage that doesn't come through, incomplete documentation. We anticipate them and, when they appear, we resolve them.
